expected_failure_transport: Invalid manifest/task/preflight can fail before batch/index directory exists.

API catches OSError/ValueError/KeyError/TypeError into typed error response with stage/code/class/reason; TMCError is a ValueError.
Unexpected BaseException marks current case error, batch interrupted, remaining not_run, saves index in finally and propagates; no retry.

logging_and_force.force: No force/--force API or CLI parameter. Unknown force options rejected; existing output dirs refused. This is separate from actual permitted mechanical force evaluations.
